chunks: This has been Our way with the apostles whom We sent before you. You will not find any variation in Our line of action.

key_terms.سُنَّة: Way, custom, or established pattern of action

ai.seo_question: What does 'sunnah' mean in the context of God's dealings with prophets?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Isra (17:76) underscores the immutable divine law (sunnah) governing the reception of prophets, affirming that the Prophet Muhammad follows the same established pattern as his predecessors. In Shia exegesis, this consistency highlights the continuity of revelation and serves as a reassurance that the challenges faced by the Prophet mirror those of earlier messengers, validating his mission through historical precedent.
